entries.label: Très légère
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a separate FRONT HEADGEAR OVERLAY for a native 64x64 cyberpunk roguelike character.
The reference image is ONLY the accepted Bastion armor material/style guide: matte ivory protection, charcoal fabric/joints, a small burnt-orange accent, simple broad faceted shading. Do not draw that body.
Draw ONE isolated piece of futuristic melee-soldier headgear in a FLAT STRAIGHT-FRONT worn position, compatible with a broad adult male human head. NO person, flesh, face, eye, hair, skull, mannequin, neck, shoulders, body, stand or ground. This overlay will be placed over the original existing head, which must remain visible through any OPEN face area.
CRITICAL: draw only the physical headgear itself. Where the face would be visible, leave GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha-zero empty space, not a black face, dark inner helmet, glass, mannequin or tinted rectangle. Only fully enclosed designs may have an opaque visor and mask. No back interior shell across an open face opening. No chin straps hanging below the jaw, cords, spikes or antenna.
Native game headgear is only 8-12 pixels wide and 4-11 pixels high. Use VERY FEW large clear shapes, dark continuous outline, 2-3 broad value shades per material, almost no texture. No screws, rivets, tiny seams, small vents or decorative details. Light from upper-left, consistent with the reference. Face exactly forward, no 3/4 turn, perspective display or side view.
Center the entire item with generous transparent margins. True transparent background outside and through open face areas. No text, labels, glow, aura, vignette or shadow.
01 VERY LIGHT: a low close-fitting charcoal PADDED SKULLCAP with a single broad warm-grey forehead band and a tiny burnt-orange side patch. Only a compact shallow cap on the crown; no visor, side guards, ear cups, cheek guards or mask. Its simple shallow profile should be about twice as wide as high. The entire face area BELOW the forehead band is absent/transparent. A practical close-fitting protective work cap, not a baseball cap or hair.

native_framing_note: Closed helmets extend into the head/neck seam before the body ownership clip at Y=12. This avoids exposed face-edge pixels without altering the accepted body or repainting either source.
